approval_source.question_set: Whether E03's negative-peer cases may target the current staging hosts, and how the runner reaches them

reason: E03 refuses dispatch until (a) its hosts run only Dytallix (E03 dedicated-hosts decision, 29 September 2026), with the runner and its reviewed preflight re-pinned to them, (b) its inert checks pass on the v3 binaries, and (c) a formally independent review (P02) approves one bounded case. The production hosts were rebuilt for dytallix-staging-2 and are console-only, while the runner reaches hosts over SSH. This record covers only the founder's part; it is not and does not replace the P02 review.

decisions.question: Do the staging hosts now count as dedicated
decisions.selected: Yes: the hosts are dedicated (nothing else runs on them) during E03
decisions.rule: The hosts run only Dytallix for the whole of E03.

unset: How the runner reaches the hosts (they are console-only and the runner uses SSH)
The amd64 inert check: where and when it runs
Who performs the P02 independent review: not chosen; E03 cannot dispatch without it
Re-pinning the runner and its reviewed preflight to the rebuilt hosts (changes the runner's hash)
does_not_authorize: any E03 dispatch before the P02 review record exists
the malformed-peer case before a separate first-case decision on the wrong-key case
